source: Chapter 696: Feathers
target: Capitulum 696: Pennæ

source: Translator: CKtalon
target: Interpretationem paravit: CKtalon

source: In Twanaku’s house in Tizamo Town, Amandina woke up amidst the violent shaking of the building.
target: In domo Twanaku in oppido Tizamo, Amandina inter violenta aedificii tremores evigilavit.

source: She stood up groggily and looked out the window.
target: Illa torpida surrexit et per fenestram aspexit.

source: The sky had turned gray and was pressing down, completely obscuring the crimson moon and stars.
target: Caelum griseum factum erat et premebat, prorsus lunam coccineam et stellas obscurans.

source: In the near-absolute darkness, Amandina turned and cast her gaze not far away.
target: In tenebris paene absolutis, Amandina se vertit et oculos in proximo loco fixes habuit.

source: Dressed neatly, Robert rose slowly, his sluggish movements suggesting he was struggling to adapt to the lightless environment.
target: Indutus eleganter, Robert lente surrexit, et motus eius tardissimi indicabant eum in ambitu sine lumine aptare luctari.

source: When the tremors in the ground and buildings finally ceased, Robert used his Spirit Vision to spot Amandina.
target: Cum tremores in terra et aedificiis tandem cessaverunt, Robert visionem spiritualem ad Amandinam deprehendendam usus est.

source: After a moment’s hesitation, he asked, “Are we awake?”
target: Post momentum dubitationis, rogavit: “Evigilavimusne?”

source: He recalled that before entering the Dream Festival, he and Amandina had used a date as an excuse to rendezvous.
target: Recordatus est quod ante Festival Somniorum intrandum, ille et Amandina diem praetextum habuerant ad conveniendum.

source: When they ended up in the special dream, they temporarily parted ways—one stayed put while the other went to Saint-Sien Cathedral.
target: Cum in somnio speciali versarentur, ad tempus se divisere: unus mansit, dum alter ad Cathédralem Sancti-Sien processit.

source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: Glancing at the suddenly noisy street outside, Amandina thought for a few seconds before replying, “Probably… but I don’t know what’s going on.”
target: Spectans viam extra subito strepitosam, Amandina paucis momentis meditata respondit: “Fortasse... sed nescio quid agatur.”

source: As Robert recalled the dream encounters, both fell silent.
target: Dum Robert congressus somniorum recordabatur, ambo silentium ceperunt.

source: Eventually, he asked in a deep voice, “What happened to you in the end?”
target: Denique, voce profunda rogavit: “Quid tibi tandem evenit?”

source: Amandina suddenly chuckled.
target: Amandina subito levis risum effecit.

source: “Nothing much.”
target: «Nihil nimis.»

source: Robert closed his mouth again.
target: Robert iterum os clausit.

source: With her night vision, Amandina looked at him, smiling with mixed emotions.
target: Per visionem nocturnam, Amandina eum intuebatur, subridente et affectibus mixtis.

source: “Is there anything else you want to ask?”
target: «Numquid aliud rogare vis?»

source: After a long pause, Robert said, “What did you experience afterward?”
target: Post longam mora, Robert dixit: “Quid postea tibi evenit?”

source: Taking in the silence of the house, Amandina finally whispered, “1 saw the one who granted me powers.”
target: In silentio domus, Amandina denique susurravit: “Ego vidi illum qui mihi potentias dedit.”

source: “The one who granted you powers?” Robert asked, surprised.
target: «Illum qui tibi potentias dedit?» rogavit Robert, miratus.

source: Amandina laughed.
target: Amandina risit.

source: “We didn’t actually fall asleep after touching the black ancient tomb.
target: «Non revera obdormivimus postquam sepulcrum antiquum nigrum tetigimus,

source: We only truly fainted after receiving the powers.”
target: verum solum exanimavimus postquam potentias accepimus.»

source: “How is that possible…” Robert looked incredulous.
target: «Quomodo id fieri potest...» inquit Robert, incredulus.

source: Amandina didn’t try to convince him.
target: Amandina eum persuadere non conata est.

source: Instead, she muttered, “Upon acquiring superpowers, one immediately falls into a coma or slumber.
target: At potius, illa submurmuravit: “Superpotentias adeptus, statim in torpor aut soporem inciditur,

source: When they wake up, they completely grasp that power.
target: cum evigilabunt, illam potentiam omnino percipient.

source: Their spirit and flesh undergo a certain transformation…”
target: Spiritus eorum atque caro mutationem aliquam subeunt…

source: “Is this considered a low-level death before rebirth?”
target: «Num hoc mortem gradus inferioris ante renascentiam existimatur?»

source: “What are you talking about?” Robert’s confusion grew.
target: «Quid dicis?» inquit Robert, confusio eius crescens.

source: It was completely incomprehensible!
target: Erat prorsus incomprehensibile!

source: Amandina’s eyes darted around as she smiled.
target: Oculi Amandinae circum volitaverunt, dum illa subridebat.

source: “That person told me.
target: «Ille mihi dixerat.

source: Perhaps it’s a form of guidance.”
target: Fortasse est forma admonitionis.»

source: “Guidance…”
target: «Admonitio…»

source: Using his Spirit Vision, the only way to ascertain her condition in the darkness, Robert gazed at Amandina.
target: Usus visionem spiritualem, qua sola in tenebris eius condicio cognoscere poterat, Robert in Amandinam aspexit.

source: He felt his fiancee was different, as if she had grown up overnight.
target: Sensit sponsam suam esse diversa, quasi illa per unam noctem adultior fieret.

source: Amandina wanted to recount the encounter in detail as usual, but swallowed her words.
target: Amandina conventum minutatim narrare cuperat, sed verba sua retinuit.

source: Sighing, she said, “Aren’t you going to check on Padre Cali?
target: Suspirans, illa dixit: “Nonne vis inspicere de Padre Cali?

source: He might not have long to live.”
target: Fortasse non diu vixerit.”

source: Snapping out of his reverie, Robert blurted out, “He fled to the ancient tomb and was killed?”
target: Ex meditatione evasit, Robert exclamavit: “Fugit ad sepulcrum antiquum et interfectus est?”

source: “He’s indeed dead,” Amandina confirmed.
target: «Vere mortuus est,» Amandina confirmavit.

source: Robert’s expression shifted, but he didn’t inquire about the murderer’s identity.
target: Vultus Roberti mutatus est, sed de identitate caedis interrogare non audivit.

source: After a moment’s thought, Amandina said, “Before you go to Padre Cali, I need to tell you something.
target: Post aliquod momentum cogitandi, Amandina dixit: “Antequam ad Padre Cali perres, tibi aliquid dicendum habeo.

source: “The desire you felt when you first faced him didn’t come from your heart.
target: «Desiderium, quod primo eum occurrens sensit, non ex corde tuo orta est;

source: He prayed to a Demon through a ritual and obtained the power to influence you.”
target: oravit ad Daemonem per ritum et potestatem te influendi adeptus est.»

source: Robert’s eyes widened, his mouth gaped, but no sound came out.
target: Oculi Roberti dilatati sunt, osque eius aperitum erat, sed nihil sonitum edidit.

source: Without further ado, Amandina strode past him towards the staircase.
target: Sine mora, Amandina praeter eum ad scalas processit.

source: Pressing down on the railing, she paused and tersely acknowledged, “Let’s find an excuse to annul the engagement.
target: Railing prementi, subsedit et breviter agnovit: “Inveniamus praetextum ut sponsalitatem dissolvamus;

source: I can accept other things about you, but 1 can’t accept how my fiance allowed me to follow Louis Berry alone to find the black ancient tomb under those circumstances.
target: alia de te accipere possum, sed non ferre possum quomodo sponsus meus mihi permisit solam sequi Louis Berry ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum sub talibus condicionibus.”

source: “Don’t worry, 1 won’t tell anyone about your matters.
target: «Noli timere, nihil de rebus tuis narrabo;

source: Those who knew in my dream won’t tell either.”
target: qui in somnio meo noverunt, neque ipsi narrabunt.»

source: Robert spun around, his gaze fixed on the staircase as Amandina descended step by step, the darkness engulfing her spirituality’s light.
target: Robert circumversus est, oculos in scalas fixos habens, dum Amandina gradatim descendebat, tenebrae lumen spirituale eius opprimebant.

source: Leaving Twanaku’s house, Amandina stepped onto the street.
target: Ex domo Twanaku discedens, Amandina in viam processit.

source: She glanced at the dark, low sky, the sporadic lights on both sides, and caught a whiff of the dusty air.
target: Illa aspiciebat caelum obscurum et humile, lumina sporadica utrinque, et odor pulveris aëris percipiebatur.

source: With her hand covering her nose, Amandina made her way towards the manor, her steps gradually quickening.
target: Manu nasum obtegente, Amandina ad villa processit, gressibus paulatim acceleratis.

source: On the third floor of the police headquarters in Tizamo Town, just as Camus felt Kolobo’s trembling subside, as if he had composed himself, painful curses echoed from the next room.
target: In tertio tabulato praefectorii vigilum in oppido Tizamo, simulquam Camus tremorem Kolobo quietari sensit, acerba maledicta ex proximo conclavi resonaverunt.

source: His heart stirred as he lit a candle and pushed open the slightly deformed wooden door.
target: Cor eius excitatum est dum candelam accendit et ostium ligneum leviter deformatum aperuit.

source: Inside, he saw the Feysacian, Loban, lying on the ground, clutching his knee and screaming in agony.
target: Intus vidit Feysacianum Loban, qui in terra iacebat, genu strinxens et dolore clamorans.

source: The member of the Tizamo patrol team had woken from the earthquake-like commotion and tried to get out of bed to find cover, but one leg strangely lost strength, accompanied by intense pain, causing him to collapse.
target: Membrum turmae vigilum Tizamo ex motu quasi terraemotu evigilavit et conatus est ex lecto surgere ad tutelam quaerendam, sed unus crus mirabiliter robur amisit, cum dolore intenso comitante, qui eum ad casum impulit.

source: Before Camus could organize his thoughts, Rhea’s voice echoed beside him.
target: Antequam Camus cogitationes suas componere poterat, vox Rhea iuxta eum resonavit.

source: “Don’t worry.
target: «Noli timere.

source: It’s the mass hysteria mentioned in the investigations.
target: Est perturbatio massiva, quam in inquisitionibus commemoratur.

source: You’ll recover after going to the corresponding Mass.”
target: Postquam ad Massam pervenies, convalesces.»

source: Having cooperated with Camus to investigate the abnormalities in Tizamo, Loban quickly understood Rhea.
target: Cum Camus ad in Tizamo anomalias investigandas cooperaret, Loban celeriter Rhea intellexit.

source: Cursing, he struggled to his feet, retrieved a military flask from under his pillow, and downed a few gulps of liquor.
target: Maledicens, ad pedes conatus est et ex sub pulvillo suo ampullam militarem repetivit, deinde aliquot sorbos liquoris deglutivit.

source: After drinking until color returned to his face, Loban sighed with relief.
target: Postquam bibit, et vultus eius color restitutus est, Loban leviter suspiravit in solatio.

source: “I feel my knee has recovered a little.
target: «Sento genu meum paulo reparatum esse.

source: Sometimes, alcohol is more useful than Mass!”
target: Aliquando, liquor utilior est quam Missa!»

source: Breathing a sigh of relief, Camus turned to Rhea, realizing his teammate’s expression had turned colder.
target: Suspirans leviter, Camus ad Rhea se convertit, animadvertens vultum socii sui frigidiorem factum esse.

source: After what just happened, her dream projection has completely vanished.
target: Post ea quae nuper acciderunt, imago somniorum eius prorsus evanuit.

source: Have the emotions and desires returned to her body?
target: An affectus et desideria ad corpus eius redierunt?

source: Will the special dreamscape still exist, and will there be a Dream Festival next year?
target: Num locus specialis somniorum adhuc exsistet, et eritne Festival Somniorum anno proximo?

source: Camus instantly made many connections.
target: Camus statim multas coniunctiones fecit.

source: At that moment, Rhea said to him, “Let’s go out and see if we can save some people.
target: Illo momento, Rhea ei dixit: “Eamus extra et videamus num aliquos servare possimus.

source: Those who died during the Dream Festival shouldn’t be the only ones injured.”
target: Qui in Festival Somniorum mortui sunt, non solum laesi esse debent.”

source: Taken aback, Camus replied, “Okay.”
target: Attonitus, Camus respondit: “Bene.”

source: Joy welled up in his heart, sensing Rhea hadn’t undergone any fundamental changes due to the return of her emotions and desires.
target: Gaudium in corde eius oriebatur, sentiens Rhea nullas mutationes fundamentales passa esse ex affectuum et desideriorum reditu.

source: Following the Brieu Motel owner’s instructions, Lumian arrived on the fourth floor and opened the corresponding room’s wooden door.
target: Sectus praeceptis domini Brieu Motel, Lumian in quarto tabulato pervenit et ostium ligneum camerae correspondentis aperuit.

source: The near pitch-black darkness receded under a blazing white fireball’s illumination, revealing everything to Lumian.
target: Tenebrae paene absolutae recedebant sub lume globuli ignis candidi fulgenti, omnia Lumiano patefaciens.

source: Some items had fallen due to the tremors, tables and chairs had shifted, and a small amount of dust had sprinkled from the ceiling.
target: Nonnulla obiecta propter tremores ceciderant, mensae et cathedrae commotae erant, et parva quantitas pulveris ex laqueari sparsa erat.

source: The window was tightly shut, but the glass had shattered.
target: Fenestra arcte clausa erat, sed vitrum confractum erat.

source: Apart from this, there was nothing noteworthy, and no sign of humans.
target: Praeter hoc, nihil notabile erat, nec ulla vestigia hominum.

source: Scanning the area, Lumian found no trace of the man or woman.
target: Circumspiciens, Lumian nullum vestigium viri vel feminae invenit.

source: Frowning, he muttered to himself, According to the original Dream Festival’s rules, death in a dream doesn’t equate to immediate death.
target: Fringens, sibi ipsi murmurat: “Secundum regulas originalis Festival Somniorum, mors in somnio non aequatur morte immediata.”

source: Did they leave Tizamo after waking up?
target: Discesseruntne ex Tizamo postquam evigilaverunt?

source: 1 planned to take care of their corpses and inherit their Beyonder characteristics…
target: Ego consilium ceperam ut cadavera eorum curarem et notiones Beyonder eorum hereditarem…

source: Lumian didn’t believe the man and woman couldn’t leave just because the door and window were tightly shut.
target: Lumian non credidit virum et feminam discedere posse solum quod ianua et fenestra arcte clausae essent.

source: After all, they were two Mid-Sequence Beyonders, and one was even a Devil.
target: Nam erant duo Mid-Sequence Beyonders, et unus etiam Diabolus.

source: Perhaps they had special abilities to resolve that problem.
target: Fortasse speciales potentias ad illud problema solvendum haberent.

source: As Lumian contemplated searching for traces and chasing after them to eliminate the deceased on behalf of the Dream Festival, he casually examined the room’s various details.
target: Dum Lumian cogitabat vestigia quaerere et eos insequi, ut pro Festival Somniorum decessos tolleret, leviter singula conclavi pervestigavit.

source: Suddenly, his pupils dilated, and his eyes froze.
target: Subito, pupillae eius dilatatae sunt, et oculi eius immobiliter fixi sunt.

source: He saw a feather lying quietly under the recliner by the window—a white feather stained with light‐yellow oil!
target: Vidit pennam quiete iacentem sub solio iuxta fenestram—pennam albam, oleo leviter flavido tinctam!

source: Lumian’s scalp tingled as he silently took two steps back into the corridor.
target: Caput Lumiani formicatione pervassum sensit, dum silentiose duos gradus in corridorium recedebat.

source: Like Reaza, were the man and woman already dead and had undergone an abnormality?
target: Sicut Reaza, an vir et femina iam mortui essent et mutationem aliquam abnormem passi essent?

source: What about their corpses?
target: Quid de cadaveribus eorum?

source: Disappeared?
target: Evanuerunt?

source: Would humans who had ascended to godhood exhibit different behaviors after leaving the Dream Festival?
target: Num homines, qui ad deitatem ascendesserunt, diversa mores post Festival Somniorum ostenderent?

source: With a blazing white fireball floating behind him, Lumian scrutinized the room, filled with questions.
target: Globulo ignis candidi fulgenti post eum volitante, Lumian conclave percontatus est, plurimis quaestionibus imbutus.

source: Perhaps the man and woman’s “corpses” were still here, but he couldn’t see them.
target: Fortasse cadavera viri et feminae hic adhuc mansere, sed ea videre non potuit.

source: Cautiously entering, he approached the recliner, sensing nothing unusual and discovering no signs of the formless object.
target: Cautius intravit atque ad lectum reclinabilem accessit, nihil insolitum sentiens neque signa rei informis reperiens.

source: Lumian retrieved the Mystery Prying Glasses and the Eye of Truth from his Traveler’s Bag, donning them one by one.
target: Lumian specula Mysterii et Oculum Veritatis ex sacco viatoris extraxit, ea singillatim induens.

source: He still couldn’t see the man and woman.
target: Adhuc virum et feminam videre non potuit.

source: His vision was filled with chaotic darkness, a dark river, oily feathers, and imprisoning darkness.
target: Visio eius repleta erat tenebris caoticis, flumine obscuro, pennis oleosis, et tenebris captivantis.

source: Upon returning to reality, did they immediately undergo immortal ascension and leave this place?
target: Redierunt ad realitatem, an statim immortales ascenderunt et hunc locum reliquerunt?

source: Lumian pondered for a few seconds before activating the black mark on his right shoulder, teleporting to a spot in the forest at the special dream’s periphery.
target: Lumian paucis secundis meditatus est, deinde notam nigram in umero dextro suo activavit et se ad locum in silva, in extremitate somnii specialis, teleportavit.

source: As a Hunter, Lumian had memorized the correct route and environmental characteristics after Amandina led him to the black ancient tomb.
target: Ut Venator, Lumian iter rectum et condiciones ambientis notas postquam Amandina eum ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum duxit, meminisse poterat.

source: After nearly fifteen minutes, he arrived at an area where numerous tree roots protruded from the ground, resembling blood vessels.
target: Post fere quindecim minuta, ad locum pervenit ubi multae radices arborum ex terra eminere videbantur, sanguineis vasculis similes.

source: However, the place where the black stone-like ancient tomb should have stood was empty.
target: At locus, ubi sepulcrum antiquum quasi lapideo nigrum steterit, vacuum erat.

source: Does that black ancient tomb only exist in dreams and can’t be encountered in reality?
target: Num illud sepulcrum antiquum nigrum tantum in somnis existat et in re inveniri non possit?

source: Lumian speculated seriously.
target: Lumian serio speculatus est.

source: So the Pale Empress and the other Angels can’t descend personally and can only send people to participate in the Dream Festival?
target: Ergo Imperatrix Pallida et ceteri Angeli personaliter descendere non possunt; solum homines mittere ad Festival Somniorum possunt?

source: As his thoughts raced, Lumian’s gaze darted back and forth across the land corresponding to the black ancient tomb.
target: Dum cogitationes eius festinabant, oculi Lumiani per terram, quae ad sepulcrum antiquum nigrum pertinebat, circum volitabant.

source: It was indeed a little different from its surroundings—no intertwined tree roots protruded from the ground, and it was flat and stoneless.
target: Revera paulo a circumstantibus differebat—radices arborum implicatae non protuberabant, et solum planum atque sine lapidibus erat.

source: Approaching thoughtfully, Lumian took out his straight sword and used it as a shovel, attempting to dig into the soil.
target: Accedens mente meditans, Lumian gladium rectum extraxit et ut scapus usus est, terram fodire conans.

source: Just as he dug a small pit, his eyelids twitched.
target: Modo ut parvam foveam fodisset, palpebra eius concussae sunt.

source: Buried in the dark brown soil were two white feathers stained with light‑yellow oil!
target: In terra fusca obscura erant duo pennæ albae, oleo leviter flavido tinctae!

source: Taking a slow breath, Lumian dug deeper.
target: Leniter spiritum accipiens, Lumian terram profundius fodit.

source: Before long, a palm‑sized, dark, slightly moist, and sticky soil lump came into view..
target: Mox in conspectu apparuit glomerulus terrae, magnitudine palmae, obscurus, paulo humidus et adhaerens.
